note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate are all described; details of the wing microsculpture and venation are omitted, as are the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate body length (including wings) about 18.0 mm, compound eyes large and round, ocellus 0.07 mm from the compound eye; soldier head capsule pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae, bare dorsally; worker dimorphic, major worker body length 5.0–5.8 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown, nasus slightly paler; antennae brown to dark brown; tibiae and tarsi paler; abdominal tergites brownish, sternites paler. Head with 4 long setae; body bare dorsally, only the last 2 abdominal tergites and sternites with a few setae. Body length 4.0–4.70 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae: head length including nasus 1.70–1.80 mm, excluding nasus 1.06–1.20 mm, maximum width 1.14–1.20 mm, width at constriction 0.75–0.80 mm, cephalic constriction index 0.65–0.69; posterior part strongly projecting, cephalic bubble length 0.40–0.50 mm, bubble index 0.33–0.42; in lateral view strongly incurved, occiput markedly raised. Compound eye small, appearing as a white spot. Nasus conical and short, close to half the head length (length 0.50–0.60 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.42–0.50). Antennae slender, 14-segmented; segment 3 twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Mandibles vestigial, each with a brown, long, pointed, spine-like process. A fine white line along the middle of the thorax. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, about half as long as wide (length 0.35–0.40 mm, width 0.65 mm); anterior margin weakly convex, without a notch; posterior margin strongly convex, without a notch. Hind tibia length 2.40–2.50 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule dark brown; antennae and femora brown; thorax chestnut brown; abdominal tergites light brown. Head and body bare dorsally, hairy ventrally. Body length 5.0–5.8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 1.15–1.20 mm, maximum width 1.30–1.35 mm); mandibular suture distinct. Fontanelle plate slightly elongate, white. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. Postclypeus inflated, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, slightly longer than half its width (length 0.45–0.50 mm, width 0.65–0.70 mm); anterior margin weakly convex, without a notch; posterior margin strongly convex, without a notch. Minor worker: as the major worker but smaller, antennal segment 3 equal in length to segment 2 (longer in the major worker), anterolateral part of the pronotum not deeply notched (deeply notched in the major worker).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown; postclypeus chestnut brown with a reddish tinge; antennae brown; abdominal tergites chestnut brown, sternites light brown. Head sparsely hairy, body densely hairy. Body length including wings about 18.0 mm, excluding wings 9.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 1.10 mm, width including compound eyes 1.63–1.75 mm); mandibular suture indistinct. Fontanelle plate elongate, milk white. Compound eyes large, round, maximum diameter 0.60 mm. Ocellus elliptical, semi-transparent (long diameter 0.20 mm, short diameter 0.15 mm), situated at about 1/2 the short diameter from the compound eye (ocellus–compound eye distance 0.07 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 about 1.5 to nearly 2 times segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus inflated, sparsely hairy, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum trapezoidal, much longer than half its width (length 0.90–0.99 mm, width 1.45 mm); anterior margin nearly straight, without a median notch; posterior margin nearly straight. Wings pale smoky brown, densely covered with short setae; fore wing length about 14.45–16.00 mm, hind wing about 13.70 mm.
